newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Study sees Australia, Brazil iron ore leaders.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Study sees Australia, Brazil iron ore leaders.

text.p: Australia and Brazil are expected to remain the world's dominant suppliers of iron ore to the seaborne trade, an industry report said on Wednesday.

The geological advantages of each country means their ore reserves can be mined in large-scale operations at low mining costs and relatively cheap beneficiation costs, the report by AME Mineral Economics Pty Ltd said.
Brazil enjoys a low waste-to-ore ratio and high production, while Australia has high production ratios and low inland transportation costs, it said.
